title: Elevator pitch: Rocky meets Milky White? #projecthailmary #broadway
transcript: For all the movie fans out there watching Project Hail Mary right now, I have to explain that it's very funny for us theater fans to watch James Ortiz, the voice and puppet designer behind Rocky, have this big moment in the spotlight. Because like, we know him as this kind of semi niche but like, prominent in his field, theater artist. And now he's like co starring in the biggest blockbuster right now. To use a comparison that film fans might understand in terms of like, the scale of visibility, it's a little bit like if Nicholas Britell the film composer, ran for president. Especially because, again, even though he is very prominent in his field, his milky white puppet for into the Woods got a lot of attention. His show the woodsman, which was a prequel to Wizard of Oz, was a big hit off Broadway. And he's done a lot of really cool projects along the way and made a big name for himself. It's still mostly like the die hard theater fans and people in the industry who like, actually know his name and like, recognise his work from project to project. So it's very cool, but also kind of surreal to see him basically co star in this massive blockbuster opposite one of the biggest movie stars in the world. But incredibly well deserved because he is such a skilled artist. I think we should just give him his own movie. Give him his own Franchise
